novel_features.name: SLA breach forecast
novel_features.description: See which open tickets will breach SLA in the next N hours, ranked by time-to-due, before they breach.
novel_features.rationale: The API only filters already-breached tickets; forecasting needs local dueDate math and ranking across every synced ticket.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this to act before a breach instead of reporting one after.

novel_features.name: Weighted agent load
novel_features.description: See which agents are actually overloaded right now, weighting open tickets by priority and age versus the team median.
novel_features.rationale: Requires a cross-agent GROUP BY aggregation that no single Desk API endpoint provides.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use before reassigning work to find the real bottleneck, not just raw counts.

novel_features.name: Composite triage queue
novel_features.description: One ranked queue merging unassigned, overdue, and high-priority tickets with a combined score.
novel_features.rationale: A union of three conditions with scoring is not expressible as a single API filter.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Start the day here: the single list of what needs attention first.

novel_features.name: Overnight changes
novel_features.description: Every ticket modified within a time window, with its current status, priority, and assignee, sorted most-recent first.
novel_features.rationale: A modifiedTime-windowed scan across every synced ticket; the API has no across-tickets recent-activity endpoint.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to catch up on what moved while you were away.

novel_features.name: Contact 360
novel_features.description: Everything about one customer in one view: their contact record, account, and every ticket with status and priority.
novel_features.rationale: A three-table local join (contacts, accounts, tickets) keyed on a contact email, served offline.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use before a call to load full customer context in one command.

novel_features.name: Morning dashboard
novel_features.description: A single brief composing breach forecast, agent load, and overnight changes.
novel_features.rationale: Pure local orchestration of three queries into one scriptable summary.
novel_features.why_it_matters: The one command to run at the start of a shift.

novel_features.name: Rebalance planner
novel_features.description: Proposes ticket moves from overloaded agents to idle ones, then optionally applies them in bulk.
novel_features.rationale: Local load optimization producing a move plan, then batched API writes.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to even out queues without hand-picking each reassignment.

novel_features.name: Breach history
novel_features.description: Who breached SLA and the trend, grouped by agent or department.
novel_features.rationale: Historical SLA aggregation and trend the API does not compute.

narrative.headline: The only scriptable, agent-native CLI for Zoho Desk: every ticket operation plus a local SQLite store, offline search, and SLA/triage analytics no help-desk tool ships.
narrative.value_prop: Manage tickets, contacts, accounts, and agents from the command line with automatic OAuth token refresh, multi-data-center handling, and auto-pagination with 429 backoff. Then go beyond the API: sla-radar forecasts breaches before they happen, agent-load finds the real bottleneck, triage builds one ranked queue, and morning composes your whole shift brief.
narrative.auth_narrative: Zoho Desk uses OAuth2 with a permanent refresh token and 1-hour access tokens. Register a self-client at api-console.zoho.com, grant Desk scopes, and exchange the code for a refresh token. Set ZOHO_DESK_CLIENT_ID, ZOHO_DESK_CLIENT_SECRET, and ZOHO_DESK_REFRESH_TOKEN; the CLI refreshes access tokens automatically. Every call also needs your orgId (run 'organizations list' to find it) and the right data center.

quickstart.comment: Check config and reachability before anything else
Find your orgId (required on every other call)
Pull tickets/contacts/agents into the local store
See the ranked queue of what needs attention first
Catch tickets about to breach SLA

troubleshoots.fix: orgId is missing or belongs to a different portal than your token. Run 'organizations list' and set the right orgId.
Your accounts data center does not match where the client was registered. Set the correct --dc / ZOHO_DC.
You hit the concurrency or daily credit cap. The CLI honors Retry-After and backs off; lower --concurrency or wait.
Lists cap at 100 per page. Use 'sync' (auto-paginates) or raise --from to page through.

narrative.when_to_use: Reach for this CLI when you need to script or automate Zoho Desk: bulk ticket operations, scheduled exports, cross-ticket analytics, SLA monitoring, or feeding ticket data to an agent. It is the right tool when the web UI is too slow or cannot express the query, and when you want offline, pipeable, JSON output.
anti_triggers: Do not use for end-user ticket submission portals; use the customer-facing Help Center.
Do not use for Zoho CRM, Books, or other Zoho products; this is Desk-only.
Do not use for real-time chat/IM; Desk threads are async email-style conversations.
